---
name: Feature request
about: A new operation, or a change to an existing one
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What do you want to do to a PDF that you can't do today?**
Describe the operation from the user's point of view — what goes in, what
comes out, what options it needs.

**Is this close to an existing tool?**
If it's a variant of something already in the app (see the README's operation
list), say which one and how this differs.

**Any external dependency this would need?**
If it needs a new Python package or an external binary, note it here — see
the README's "Licensing" section before proposing an AGPL/GPL dependency as
anything other than an optional subprocess.

**Would this fit as a single `@register`-decorated operation?**
Most things do (see CONTRIBUTING.md's "Adding an operation" section) — if
you think it's a bigger architectural change instead, explain why.
